values.statement_of_facts:
1. The appellant, Arun Demo Agarwal, is a resident individual carrying on a trading business. This is a wholly fictional demonstration case for AY 2024-25.

2. The appellant filed the return on 31/07/2024, acknowledgment number 240731000000001, declaring total income of Rs.12,00,000. Tax including cess of Rs.1,79,400 was fully covered by the assumed TDS credit. A valid old-regime election is assumed for training.

3. A scrutiny notice dated 20/08/2024 was served on 21/08/2024. A questionnaire dated 10/08/2026 was served on 11/08/2026. Replies were submitted on 25/08/2026 and 08/09/2026, the latter answering the proposed variation dated 01/09/2026. The replies referred to invoices and bank payments for the disputed expenses.

4. The order dated 24/09/2026 under section 143(3) read with section 144B determined total income of Rs.17,00,000 after disallowing business expenses of Rs.5,00,000. The AO concluded that supporting particulars were insufficient. The appellant disputes the disallowance.

5. The constructed computation shows income tax of Rs.3,22,500, cess of Rs.12,900 and interest of Rs.46,800, less TDS of Rs.1,79,400, resulting in demand of Rs.2,02,800. The fictional demand notice was served on 25/09/2026.

6. The intended filing date for this demonstration is 05/10/2026. The appellant contests the expense addition and consequential demand on the following grounds. All identifiers and transactions in this teaching pack are synthetic.

values.grounds_of_appeal:
1. On the facts and in the circumstances of the fictional case, the Assessing Officer erred in disallowing business expenses of Rs.5,00,000 in full without properly appreciating the invoices, expense particulars and bank-payment records referred to in the appellant's replies.

2. The Assessing Officer erred in determining total income at Rs.17,00,000 instead of the returned income of Rs.12,00,000. The appellant seeks deletion of the disputed expense disallowance and consequential recomputation of tax and interest.

3. The appellant craves leave to add, alter, amend or withdraw any ground before disposal of the appeal.
